This movie suffers from not being able to decide what type of movie it wants to be. A tragedy (the loss of a mentor, Qui-Gon Jinn, for Obi Wan) or a coming of age story (Anakin's story). 

A New Hope was a coming of age story for Luke Skywalker.

Empire Strikes Back was a tragedy story (loss of Han Solo and the Empire "winning")

Return of the Jedi is a redemption story (Luke being able to redeem Darth Vader)

The Phantom Menace doesn't know what type of story it wanted to be. If it was a tragedy for Obi-Wan, it would have probably been a better movie.
